## Architectures

<a id="flowtron"></a>

### Flowtron

Autoregressive normalizing flows over mel spectrograms.

[Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2005.05957)

![Flowtron — Figure 1](../assets/architectures/flowtron.png)

*Figure 1 · [Source](https://arxiv.org/abs/2005.05957)*

<details>
<summary>Details</summary>

**Input → output:** T, S → S · **Interaction:** generation

An invertible acoustic model supports sampling and style transfer. A separate vocoder produces the waveform.

</details>

<a id="glow-tts"></a>

### Glow-TTS

Normalizing-flow acoustic model and monotonic alignment search.

[Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2005.11129)

![Glow-TTS — Figure 1, PDF p. 3](../assets/architectures/glow-tts.png)

*Figure 1, PDF p. 3 · [Source](https://arxiv.org/abs/2005.11129)*

<details>
<summary>Details</summary>

**Input → output:** T → S · **Interaction:** generation

Learns text-to-speech alignment without an external aligner and generates mel spectrograms in parallel before vocoding.

</details>

<a id="melo-tts"></a>

### MeloTTS

VITS-family multilingual speech synthesis.

[Repository](https://github.com/myshell-ai/MeloTTS)

![MeloTTS — Input/output diagram](../assets/architectures/melo-tts.svg)

*Input/output diagram · [Source](https://github.com/myshell-ai/MeloTTS)*

<details>
<summary>Details</summary>

**Input → output:** T → S · **Interaction:** generation

The implementation builds on VITS, VITS2 and Bert-VITS2. Language and speaker selections depend on the released checkpoint.

Editorial summary of documented inputs and outputs; internal architecture is not shown.

</details>

<a id="naturalspeech"></a>

### NaturalSpeech

Text-to-waveform VAE with enhanced prior and duration modeling.

[Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2205.04421)

![NaturalSpeech — Figure 1](../assets/architectures/naturalspeech.png)

*Figure 1 · [Source](https://arxiv.org/abs/2205.04421)*

<details>
<summary>Details</summary>

**Input → output:** T → S · **Interaction:** generation

Combines phoneme pretraining, a differentiable durator, bidirectional prior/posterior modeling and a memory-equipped decoder.

</details>

<a id="portaspeech"></a>

### PortaSpeech

Variational acoustic model and flow-based post-net.

[Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2109.15166)

![PortaSpeech — Figure 1, PDF p. 4](../assets/architectures/portaspeech.png)

*Figure 1, PDF p. 4 · [Source](https://arxiv.org/abs/2109.15166)*

<details>
<summary>Details</summary>

**Input → output:** T → S · **Interaction:** generation

Combines word-level and phoneme-level alignment with a lightweight VAE; the post-net restores acoustic detail before vocoding.

</details>

<a id="vits"></a>

### VITS

Conditional VAE, normalizing flows and adversarial waveform decoding.

[Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2106.06103)

![VITS — Figure 1, PDF p. 3](../assets/architectures/vits.png)

*Figure 1, PDF p. 3 · [Source](https://arxiv.org/abs/2106.06103)*

<details>
<summary>Details</summary>

**Input → output:** T → S · **Interaction:** generation

Jointly trains text-to-waveform synthesis with a stochastic duration predictor. Reference-audio cloning is not an intrinsic capability of the original model.

</details>

<a id="vits-2"></a>

### VITS2

VITS with adversarial duration training and revised flows.

[Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.16430)

![VITS2 — Figure 1, PDF p. 2](../assets/architectures/vits-2.png)

*Figure 1, PDF p. 2 · [Source](https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.16430)*

<details>
<summary>Details</summary>

**Input → output:** T → S · **Interaction:** generation

Improves duration prediction, flow layers and speaker conditioning while reducing dependence on phoneme conversion.

</details>

<a id="yourtts"></a>

### YourTTS

Multilingual VITS with speaker-reference conditioning.

[Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2112.02418)

![YourTTS — Figure 1, PDF p. 3](../assets/architectures/yourtts.png)

*Figure 1, PDF p. 3 · [Source](https://arxiv.org/abs/2112.02418)*

<details>
<summary>Details</summary>

**Input → output:** T, S → S · **Interaction:** generation

Extends VITS for zero-shot multi-speaker synthesis; the broader model also supports voice conversion and speaker adaptation.

</details>
